statement: After a compressed day (prior range <= 0.6-0.8 of its 20-day average), the opening-range breakout is more likely to follow through.
mechanism: Volatility clustering and range expansion after contraction (Crabel; vol mean-reversion).
falsification: Compressed-day breakout no better than the same breakout on non-compressed days (baseline) or TRAIN Sharpe < 0.5.
